# Henry Freed

> Personal site of Henry Freed ([hbfreed.com](https://hbfreed.com)): machine learning projects and notes — mixture-of-experts research, model pruning and distillation, interpretability, GPU tuning — plus some bread baking.

All posts are static HTML and may be fetched directly. Markdown sources live at https://github.com/hbfreed/hbfreed.github.io.
